instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Read my Signal messages into my own records", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-my-signal-messages-on-this-computer and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Runs the Signal client (signal-cli) on your computer, which reads the messages Signal holds for this computer as a linked device, turns them into conversations (a group by its name, a person by the name their messages came with; your own messages sent from your phone are yours) and keeps them in your records the way tool:pull-my-signal-messages does: a message read twice is kept once, an edit replaces the older copy, calls are kept as calls, and receipts, typing, reactions and group changes are left out and counted.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: account-snapshot-part (records:list, records:write).
